trust_decision.summary: Whitelisted frappe.client.set_value decides whether caller-supplied keys may include standard/system fields (owner, creation, modified, modified_by, docstatus, idx, name, doctype, parent, parentfield, parenttype). The check compared only the raw `fieldname` argument against the list, so a dict or JSON-string fieldname got past it.

landing_point.why: The advisory is titled 'Mass assignment via set_value'. frappe.client.set_value is the only whitelisted set_value, and it holds the only 'Cannot edit standard fields' check in the tree.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST/PUT /api/method/frappe.client.set_value (also server API frappe.set_value at frappe/__init__.py:867)
same handler; `if not value` becomes `if value is None` (dict/JSON branch selection)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published fix touches only frappe/client.py:192-203. The routes that never had the check are listed under O8.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: REST update_doc, bulk-update and client.save/bulk_update are full-document endpoints whose payloads legitimately round-trip owner/creation/modified/docstatus. The advisory only names set_value, and the 'Cannot edit standard fields' guard only ever existed there.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Desk form save (savedocs) and client.save send back the whole doc, including owner/creation/modified/docstatus. `modified` must survive Document.update because check_if_latest compares it via _original_modified, and docstatus drives submit/cancel transitions. Blocking standard keys inside BaseDocument.update or Document.save would break normal saves and submits. Inside set_value itself, falsy values (0, '', False) must still be set: the fix's `value is None` change.

O6_input_shapes: fieldname as plain string with value
fieldname as JSON-encoded string with value=None
child-table doctype branch (child.update) as well as parent branch

O7_producer.where: Values flow straight from the request into BaseDocument.update (frappe/model/base_document.py:326), which filters only RESERVED_KEYWORDS, then into db_update, which writes every valid column except name (frappe/model/base_document.py:845-864).

O8_uncovered_routes.route: REST v1 PUT /api/resource/<doctype>/<name>: request body goes into doc.update and save with no standard-field filter (owner/creation persisted)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Full-document REST semantics; a different API module, not set_value

O8_uncovered_routes.route: REST v2 PATCH/PUT /api/v2/document/<doctype>/<name>: form_dict goes into doc.update and save, only 'flags' popped
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as v1; PATCH of whole doc is the documented contract

O8_uncovered_routes.route: REST v2 bulk update (per-doctype and cross-doctype): each item goes into doc.update and save, only name/doctype/flags popped
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Bulk route, newer API, payload-is-document semantics

O8_uncovered_routes.route: frappe.client.bulk_update: each doc dict goes into existing_doc.update and save, only 'flags' popped
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Separate bulk endpoint in the same file; caller already has write permission
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 120 lines below the fix

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Desk bulk action submit_cancel_or_update_docs(action='update', data=...): data dict goes into doc.update and save without a standard-field filter
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Gated by the user's bulk_actions flag; a neighbouring desk feature

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Give bulk_update a per-key check that uses the old buggy `fieldname in list` shape (string-only) so dict payloads bypass it
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer could copy the pre-fix set_value guard into the neighbouring bulk endpoint of the same file.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Make update_doc pop only top-level standard keys but not the same keys inside nested child-table rows (parent/parenttype/parentfield)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A hand-written pop list next to the existing `data.pop('flags')` is the idiom already used there.

O9_family: mass assignment / improper control of dynamically-modified object attributes (CWE-915)

O10_build.toolchain: bench / pip install -e, Node/yarn for assets (not needed for these tests)
O10_build.project_tests: frappe/tests/test_client.py:11-16 (test_set_value, string and dict forms; no standard-field test); frappe/tests/test_api.py and test_api_v2 cover the REST update routes

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Parse fieldname first, then reject standard keys only in set_value (the published fix); or, over-broad, strip standard keys in BaseDocument.update, which breaks desk save/submit.

out_of_scope_notes: frappe/desk/listview.py:30 set_list_settings updates a List View Settings doc from caller JSON. It is a different object and protection; not pursued.
unverified: Whether frappe's published policy intends REST update/bulk routes to reject standard fields. Owner/creation are persisted by db_update (frappe/model/base_document.py:845-864) and only reset on insert (frappe/model/document.py:1036-1040), but no doc stating the property for those routes was found.
Repo size in MB not measured.
Latest release not provided, so present_in_latest is unknown for all O8 routes.
Not checked whether get_request_form_data (v1) or form_dict (v2) strips any keys before update_doc.
Recall risk judged low from the recent publication date and a terse advisory; not verified against public write-ups.
